claims.evidence: Witness report only shows two boxed items labeled “Wireless Controller” and a white console/stand with no readable brand/model; no PS4 Pro identifiers are readable.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating.
claims.evidence: No power-on/temperature/repair history evidence is shown in the witness observations.
No ports are shown being tested; witness report notes no readable port condition.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Witness report mentions boxed items labeled “Wireless Controller” but does not confirm receipt or that controllers are original pads.

risks.risk: Console model/identity may not be PS4 Pro (could be another PS4 model or different console), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console’s label showing brand/model (e.g., CUH-7xxx for PS4 Pro) and storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown PS4 console with wireless controllers, worst-case for model uncertainty.

risks.risk: Not tested: may not power on, may have faults (overheating, faulty ports, disc drive issues).
risks.proof: A short video clip of power-on to the home screen and a quick game/menu navigation (showing no errors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified/possibly faulty electronics (worst-case), discounting heavily.

risks.risk: Controller functionality may be poor (drift, dead buttons, weak vibration, pairing issues).
risks.proof: A clip showing controller pairing and working inputs (analog movement, trigger response, vibration test) on the console.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers unverified; treat as “may need repair/replacement.”

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (missing cables, charging cable, HDMI, manuals, original box contents).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of every included accessory with a checklist (HDMI, power cable, USB/charging cable, manuals, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst-case missing cables/manuals).

risks.risk: Account/lock or network issues (PSN lock, prior account restrictions) can reduce usability.
risks.proof: A clip showing the console settings/network screen and successful sign-in/out or account status check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential network/account restriction risk.

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than claimed (scratches, dents, port damage, worn controller shells).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console exterior, vents, ports, and controller shells/joysticks from multiple angles.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console label (brand + exact model number + storage capacity).
Short video: power on to the PS home screen (no errors) and quick navigation.
Video: controller pairing and input test (analog sticks, triggers, vibration).
Photos of all included accessories laid out (HDMI, power cable, USB/charging cable, manuals) and confirmation of original packaging contents.
Photo/clip of receipt (UK receipt) and any warranty/serial documentation if available.
Close-ups of ports/vents and any visible wear or damage.
response.reason: The witness confirms only boxed “Wireless Controller” items and an unidentified console/stand with no readable PS4 Pro identifiers or testing evidence. Without model identification and power/controller functionality proof, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
